import re
import sys

name = r"(?:[a-h]|TMP)"
assignment = re.compile(
    rf"^\s*({name})\s*<-\s*"
    rf"(?:([0-9]+)|\(\s*({name})\s*\+\s*([0-9]+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100)"
    rf"\s*;\s*$"
)

values = {}

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.fullmatch(line)
    if not match:
        continue

    target, literal, source, increment = match.groups()
    if literal is not None:
        values[target] = int(literal)
    else:
        values[target] = (values[source] + int(increment)) % 100

names = [*("abcdefgh"), "TMP"]
print(" ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};" for name in names))
